question: Who was the founding President of the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Womesh Chandra Banerjee__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first president of the Congress party was in the year 1885 when it was first founded by **Womesh Chander Banerjee**.
 
• Womesh Chandra Bannerjee was an Indian barrister. 
 
• He was a student of Calcutta University and was the president of its law faculty.
 
• He presided over the first session of the Indian National Congress held at Bombay in 1885 from 28 to 31 December. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** is also known as the **"Grand Old Man of India"** and **"Unofficial Ambassador of India".** 
 
• He was an Indian political leader, merchant, scholar, and writer also who was a Liberal Party Member of Parliament in India.
 
• **Surendranath Banerjee **who is also known as **Rashtraguru** founded a nationalist organization known as the** Indian National Association **and was one of the founding members of the I**ndian National Congress**.
 
• George Yule was a Scottish merchant in England and also in India who served as the fourth President of India by National Congress in 1888 at Allahabad.
